- Reminder windows: I propose 7 days, 48 hours, 3 hours before the event. We should add an in-browser calendar add-to for registrants who click from partner emails.
- Copy: short reminder copy for engineers + longer for managers; Marissa, can you draft both? Jasmine, can you confirm UTM naming so it maps to our attribution model? Mateo — will you confirm deliverability check windows (timezones)?

HubSpot link for this campaign: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/engagements/HS-198234

Thanks — need final by EOD so we can publish the RSVP page tomorrow.

—Sean

Thanks Sean — quick notes: 

- I like the 7d / 48h / 3h cadence but recommend a 24h reminder for launch-day registrants (makes the sequence 7d, 48h, 24h, 3h) — it lifts attendance for engineers.
- Draft copy attached (short_engineer_snippets.txt in body) — keep subject lines focused on outcome: "Ship inference improvements faster" or "Bring your latency questions".
- For segment links: create separate RSVP links for "Engineers", "Platform/Infra", "CTO/Leads", and "Partner Referrals". Partner referrals should append partner_id and partner_label in the UTM so CloudOps gets credit.

On tracking matrix: I reviewed rsvp-link-matrix.xlsx and added a column for prefill fields (company_role, timezone). If we can auto-prefill role from querystring it increases conversion.

CC: @Mateo — can you confirm timezone wrap (we should send reminders relative to registrant timezone, not event host timezone)?

On attachments: I pulled the invite snippets into the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B_invite-assets/dev-office-hours

Marissa
